scope: Consume server run/cursor pairing and synchronize persisted pending approval during recovery; no visual redesign.
root_causes: RemoteThreadSnapshot ignored active_run_id; ViewModel merged cursors from different runs using maxOf.
Local pending approval was not reconciled with terminal server snapshots and local observation raced initial remote recovery.
changes: Parse active_run_id, replace resumable run/cursor in one DataStore edit; clear obsolete pending approval and cursor for closed, idle or clarifying snapshots.
Start local observation after initial remote recovery; refresh server snapshot before reconnect consumption; ignore old-run stream results and prevent old-run preference writes.
Known IO/HTTP recovery errors become explicit offline UI; unknown contract failures are not silently replaced with old state.

checks.summary: Expected server active_run_id, received null. Shell wrapper reported exit 0 despite Gradle task failure; assertion and Gradle output are authoritative.

test_boundary: JVM protocol, preference transformation and reducer tests. Preference reload is immutable in-memory readback, not process death or disk restart. ViewModel sequencing and stale-stream guards are code-reviewed and compile/lint checked, not device acceptance.
environment: Existing Java 21 and Android SDK via process variables; offline Gradle; no credential files read or dependencies installed.
git_actions: No stage, commit, push or release.
